changelog:
* **feat: easter egg is now a money game** (a92b3e4)
  - 7 taps on the Version row open the game directly, no dialog.
  - Emojis are draggable; tilting drifts them and shaking scatters them.
  - More bank and money emojis in small, medium and large sizes.
  - Game screen fades in with a staggered pop-in; back button is the only exit.
* **fix: stop ghost Sheet deleted toast** (5f43c83)
  - Consume the lastDeletedSheetId flag before the undo snackbar shows, so switching tabs can never replay a stale toast.
  - Pass the sheet id to undoDelete explicitly instead of reading the consumed flag.
* **fix: commit custom quantity on IME Done** (39f6a6c)
  - IME Done key now saves the typed value exactly like the OK button.
  - Removed the old behavior where Done only cleared focus.
* **chore: align app version with released v4.4.38** (d66ff61)
  - Bump versionCode from 28 to 89 and versionName from 4.4.20 to 4.4.38 to match the release shipped in version.json.
* **docs: refresh README and codebase reference docs** (bbb98b3)
  - Add real screenshot files section to README and drop the placeholder TODO comment.
  - Correct route count (4/8 -> 9) in AGENTS.md and README project tree; add Draft route, draft/ and onboarding/ folders.
  - Add Save as Draft and Onboarding Wizard to the README features list.
  - Create ota.md design doc from current code: manifest/changelog JSON contracts, UpdateStatus state machine, download/install flows, error matrix, CI pipeline.
  - Refresh docs/FILES.md: script-verified line counts, versionCode 89 / versionName 4.4.38, 9-route navigation map with draft + fromDraft, BanglaTextSanitizer, 9 test classes.
  - Correct AGENTS.md install mechanism note (FileProvider on all API levels; MediaStore only for report exports) and fix line-count warnings.
  - Point the SettingsViewModel state-machine comment at ota.md section 5.
* **docs: add real app screenshots to README** (b6c5bda)
  - Replace placeholder screenshots in assets/screenshots with actual app screenshots.
  - Cover Calculator, Report, History, Update available, and Up to date screens.
* **feat: warn red when custom input exceeds 5 digits** (e15f5f7)
  - Show a red Max 5 digits (99,999) message only when typing more than 5 digits.
  - Keep the field capped at 5 digits and clear the warning when input is valid again.
  - Reset the warning when Custom is toggled off or the field is cleared.
* **fix: drop Min 1 max 99,999 subtitle** (041f013)
  - Remove the Min 1, max 99,999 hint under the custom number field.
  - The custom input box now shows no subtitle by default.
* **style: shrink Custom chip label text** (60b3d16)
  - Shrink only the English Custom word in the quantity picker so it no longer overlaps.
  - Keep the Bangla label and all numeric preset chips at their original size.
* **style: render Bangla colons as bisorgo** (6477fe5)
  - Flip the remark sanitizer: in Bangla mode, punctuation colons become
    bisorgo (ঃ) instead of ASCII colons; English mode is a no-op.
  - Skip times (রাত ১১:৩০, 10:45) and colons in English text
    ("Bank: Sonali"); in-word bisorgo (দুঃখ) is never touched.
  - Drop spaces before a converted colon ("মোট : ৫০" → "মোটঃ ৫০").
  - Pass isBangla at all sanitizer call sites (reports, calculator,
    history, report preview, changelog).
  - Switch Bangla labels to ঃ in PDF (6), TXT (7), and UI screens
    (Report, History, Draft, Update, Settings, Calculator).
